tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search 20,000+ free icons across 10 libraries using AI-powered synonym expansion. Returns matching free icons with SVG code and SI semantic guidance when available. Pro API keys unlock workflow tools; premium pack icon search is not exposed through MCP yet.

library.description: Filter by free library: lucide, tabler, phosphor, heroicons, bootstrap, iconoir, ionicons, material, simpleicons, or mingcute

style.description: Optional style preference. Use `solid` only for libraries that ship fill or solid variants.

locale.description: Optional locale for multilingual search terms. Supported values: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, es, de, pt, ar, hi, vi, th.

tools.name: recommend_icons
tools.description: Recommend the most suitable icons for one or more UI slots. Returns shortlist choices with preview-ready SVGs, short reasons, and SI semantic guidance when available.

task.description: Overall UI task, for example "replace the 4 bottom navigation icons" or "choose icons for a settings panel".

library.description: Optional library filter such as mingcute, lucide, tabler, material, or simpleicons.

style.description: Optional style preference. Use `solid` to prefer filled variants where they exist.

locale.description: Optional locale for multilingual slot labels. Supported values: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, es, de, pt, ar, hi, vi, th.

slots.description: List of UI slots to fill, for example ["Home tab", "Create action", "Alerts tab", "Profile tab"].

limit_per_slot.description: How many choices to return per slot, including the top recommendation.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: Retrieve a specific free icon by its ID and library. Returns the full SVG code, metadata, and SI semantic guidance when available. Premium pack icon retrieval is not exposed through MCP yet.

style.description: Optional style preference. Use `solid` to request a filled variant when the library supports it.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List the free icon libraries available through Supericons MCP with their names, icon counts, and descriptions.

tools.name: list_motion_presets
tools.description: List the Motion Lab presets currently available through Supericons MCP, including preset id, label, group, description, and supported triggers. Motion Lab MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

tools.name: get_motion_recipe
tools.description: Return a human-readable Motion Lab recipe for a preset, trigger, and duration. Use this before export tools when you want to compare presets or confirm the motion fit. Motion Lab MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

preset.description: Motion preset id, for example pulse, bounce, spin, trace, or typing.

tools.name: export_motion_css
tools.description: Generate Motion Lab CSS for a Supericons icon. The returned CSS uses a portable {{ICON_SELECTOR}} token you replace with your inline SVG selector. Call get_motion_recipe first if you want to compare presets before exporting. Motion Lab MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

id.description: Icon ID, for example heart, scan-virus, or fingerprint-scan.

library.description: Free icon library key, for example lucide, tabler, phosphor, iconoir, or mingcute.

tools.name: export_animated_svg
tools.description: Generate a self-contained animated SVG using Motion Lab presets. Call get_motion_recipe first if you want to compare presets before exporting. Motion Lab MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

id.description: Icon ID, for example heart, scan-virus, or fingerprint-scan.

library.description: Free icon library key, for example lucide, tabler, phosphor, iconoir, or mingcute.

color.description: Optional CSS color override for icons that inherit currentColor.

tools.name: animate_icon
tools.description: Generate both Motion Lab CSS and a self-contained animated SVG for one icon. The CSS output uses a portable {{ICON_SELECTOR}} token you replace with your inline SVG selector. Call get_motion_recipe first if you want to compare presets before exporting. Motion Lab MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

id.description: Icon ID, for example heart, scan-virus, or fingerprint-scan.

library.description: Free icon library key, for example lucide, tabler, phosphor, iconoir, or mingcute.

color.description: Optional CSS color override for icons that inherit currentColor.

tools.name: inspect_converter_options
tools.description: List the current Converter MCP options, workflow hints, and recommended starting combinations. Converter MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

tools.name: inspect_converter_input
tools.description: Inspect a PNG before tracing. Returns structural hints, likely risks, and recommended starting settings for Converter MCP.

imageBase64.description: PNG as base64 text or data URL.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override. Only image/png is currently supported.

tools.name: convert_svg_to_png
tools.description: Convert an SVG string to PNG. Converter MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

background.description: Background color: `transparent` or a hex value like `#ffffff`.

tools.name: convert_png_to_svg
tools.description: Convert a PNG payload to SVG. Converter MCP is a Pro workflow tool.

imageBase64.description: PNG as base64 text or data URL.

traceClass.description: Tracing profile tuned for the source image.

uiMode.description: Output bias for logo or icon-style artwork.
